summary: Houses front the whole kerb on Swann Road; nowhere to park out of sight.
reasons: Busy through road, cars parked in lane

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes sit 0-9 m from the kerb along its full length; no gap.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed road with parked cars along the kerb; room to stop is fine.
drivers.traffic: Busy two-way through road with a median; constant traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the kerb, but every space faces a house.

flags: Dwellings within 10 m along entire stretch
Mapped locked gate 66 m away on a way round, not on only access
sun_shade: Mixed street trees and house gardens; mostly open to the west, houses shade the east.
